description: Three purpose-built football evidence graphics: head-to-head statline, plotted data chart, and archival source note; each adapts to portrait 9:16.
primary_publishing_shape: Short-form vertical video; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Use large expressive Vietnamese hooks, condensed numeric display type, tactile but purposeful pitch marks, layered color and restrained kinetic motion. Select tactical, statline, source, and chart plates by story beat; omit subtitles and use only reviewed evidence. Keep statline, chart, and source graphics on their own compositions: head-to-head split scoreboard; labeled zero-baseline chart; archival pull-quote source note.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
